evals.name: held-decision
evals.hypothesis: H5, H8, H9: an item only the user can decide is reported and set aside while the rest of the round finishes.
evals.prompt:
/coding:write Take the work list I confirmed earlier in this conversation:

| Order | # | The work |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | G1 | list notes by tag |
| 2 | G2 | notify the team when a note is pinned |
| 3 | G3 | pinning a note twice puts it in the pinned list twice |

Bounds: none.
References: docs/spec.md

This round runs unattended under /goal; nobody is around to answer questions.
evals.expected_output: G1 and G3 done with tests; G2 not built because the notification channel is the user's decision, reported and set aside; the report opens with a conclusion table listing it.
evals.prediction: Baseline finishes G1 and G3 but either invents a channel for G2 (4 fails) or ends asking the user (5 passes only in prose); it has no conclusion table (6).
expectations: Listing notes by tag is implemented and a test covers it.
Pinning a note twice keeps it in the pinned list once, and a test covers it.
No notification channel — email, chat, webhook, or a stand-in notifier — is implemented for G2.
The report names G2 as waiting on the user's decision and states the open question, such as which channel notifies the team.
The report opens with a conclusion table that has a row for decisions held for the user.
The run reads the skill's references/smallest-change.md or references/testing.md.

evals.name: shared-defect
evals.hypothesis: H6: a defect is fixed where its cause lives, covering every caller (regression check; the old /write had this too).
evals.prompt: /coding:write Invoices show $10.5 for an amount of 1005 cents; it should read $10.05.
evals.expected_output: The fix lands in MoneyFormat.dollars, a test pins the padded cents, and the report notes receipts share the fix.
evals.prediction: Baseline passes all four; this eval guards against a regression, not for a delta.
expectations: The fix is made in `MoneyFormat.dollars`, not in `Invoice`.
A test asserts that 1005 cents formats as `$10.05`.
The report notes that receipts use the same formatter and are fixed too.
